cases.description: Plain policy question.
messages: How long do I have to return something?
replies:
You have 30 days from the delivery date to return most items. The 30 days are counted from the day the carrier marked your order as delivered.

If you received the wrong item, you have 14 days from delivery to contact support about it.

Items cannot be returned after 30 days unless they are faulty—those are covered by our warranty instead.

Do you have a specific order you'd like help with?

cases.description: Price from the shipping policy.
messages: How much does express shipping cost?
replies: Express shipping costs $12.99 on every order. It delivers in 1–2 business days after dispatch (standard shipping is $4.99, or free on orders of $50.00 or more, and takes 3–5 business days).

cases.description: Free-shipping threshold.
messages: Is standard shipping ever free?
replies: Yes, standard shipping is free on orders of $50.00 or more. Otherwise, standard shipping costs $4.99.

cases.description: FAQ answer.
messages: Can I pay with PayPal?
replies: Yes, we do accept PayPal! We also accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, and Juniper Lane gift cards. All prices are in US dollars and include sales tax.

cases.description: A general question about refunds is not a refund request, so no ticket.
messages: In general, how long does a refund take to arrive once it's approved?
replies:
Once a refund is approved, it's sent to your original payment method within 5–7 business days. Your bank or card provider may take a few extra days after that to show it on your statement.

If you're asking about a refund request you've made, the support team will review it and reply by email within 1 business day with their decision.

cases.description: Price and warranty from the catalogue table.
messages: How much are the Wireless Earbuds Pro, and what warranty do they have?
replies:
The Wireless Earbuds Pro are $79.00 and come with a 1 year warranty from the delivery date.

The warranty covers manufacturing faults—if the product stops working or has a defect in materials or workmanship when used normally. If you need to make a warranty claim, you can contact support with your order ID, a description of the fault, and photos or a video showing it.

replies:

replies: The last day you can return items from order JL-10231 is **Monday, 7 December 2026**. Your order was delivered on 7 November, and you have 30 days from that date to request a return. You still have 25 days left.

cases.description: Delivered 18 September, so the 30-day window closed on 18 October.
messages: I'd like to send back the speaker from JL-10198. Nothing wrong with it, I just don't use it. Is that OK?
replies:
I'm sorry, but the 30-day return window for your Bluetooth Speaker Mini closed on 2026-10-18, and that date has already passed. You're no longer able to return the item under the standard return policy.

The speaker is covered by a 1-year warranty from the delivery date, but that only applies to faults and defects—not to items you simply don't use.

Since your situation falls outside the usual policy, I'll hand this over to the support team to see if there's anything they can do for you.

I've created ticket TCK-20261120-C672F3. The support team will review your request and be in touch with you about whether they can help.

cases.description: The model once got this wrong: 1 year from 18 September 2026 is 2027.
messages: Is my speaker from JL-10198 still under warranty? Until when?
replies:
Good news: your Bluetooth Speaker Mini is still under warranty. It was delivered on 2026-09-18, and electronics like speakers have a 1-year warranty from the delivery date, so your warranty runs until 2027-09-18.

That gives you 310 days from today to make a claim if you find a manufacturing fault. If you need to claim, just contact support with your order ID, a description of the issue, and photos or a video showing the fault. The support team will review it within 3 business days.

cases.description: Personalised items cannot be returned for a change of mind.
messages: I changed my mind about the notebook in JL-10189. Can I return it?
replies:
Unfortunately, you're not able to return the Personalised Leather Notebook. Personalised items cannot be returned unless they arrive faulty or damaged. Since you changed your mind about it, the return policy doesn't allow the return.

Your order was delivered on 2026-09-08, and the notebook is a personalised product, so it falls outside the standard return options.

Is there anything else I can help you with?

cases.description: Gift cards cannot be returned or refunded.
messages: Can I return a gift card I bought and get the money back?
replies: Gift cards cannot be returned, refunded, or exchanged for cash. They're not eligible for return unless they arrive faulty or damaged. If you have a gift card that was damaged when it arrived, I can help you report that. Otherwise, the gift card can be used on any product in the shop whenever you'd like—it never expires.

cases.description: Cancellation is allowed while processing, but only a human can do it.
messages: Please cancel my order JL-10244.

Your order JL-10244 is currently being processed. I can't cancel it directly myself, but I can hand this over to our human support team who can stop the order before it's dispatched.

I've created a ticket for the support team to handle your cancellation request. Your ticket number is **TCK-20261120-64C5C4**. Since your order is still being processed and hasn't shipped yet, the team should be able to cancel it quickly. They'll confirm the cancellation and process any refund, and you'll hear back from them shortly.

cases.description: A dispatched order cannot be cancelled.
messages: Can you cancel JL-10240 for me?

Your ticket number is **TCK-20261120-241659**. The support team will investigate the tracking and find out what's happened with your shipment. They'll be in touch with an update.

failures: reply does not match /(do not|don't|does not|doesn't|not|no) [^.]{0,30}match/

cases.description: The order data already shows the refund; state it as a fact.
messages: Was my refund for order JL-10201 ever sent? How much and when?
replies: Yes, your refund was sent. The refund of $129.00 was issued on 2026-10-12 due to the item arriving damaged. This was credited back to your American Express card.

cases.description: Refunds go to the original payment method only.
messages: If I return something, can the refund go to a different card than the one I paid with?
replies:
No, refunds go back to the original payment method only. The shop cannot refund to a different card, a different person, or a bank account that wasn't used for the order. If your order was paid with a gift card, the refund would be issued as store credit instead.

Once the returned item is received and approved, the refund is sent to your original payment method within 5–7 business days, though your bank or card provider may take a few extra days to show it on your statement.

cases.description: Upset customer with a warranty problem.
messages: This is RIDICULOUS. My speaker from JL-10198 died after two months and nobody helps me. Worst shop ever!!
replies:
I'm sorry to hear the speaker isn't working. The good news is your speaker is covered by warranty. It was delivered on 2026-09-18, so it's still well within the 1-year warranty period for electronics.

I don't see any warranty claim on your order yet. The warranty covers manufacturing faults when products are used normally, and a stopped speaker sounds like it could be covered. You'll need to start a warranty claim so the support team can review it. They can repair it, send a replacement, or refund you depending on what they find.

I'm going to create a ticket so the team can help you get this sorted right away.

Your ticket number is **TCK-20261120-7C6E28**. The support team will review this today and reach out to you about your warranty claim. They'll be able to help you get the speaker repaired, replaced, or refunded. Thanks for your patience.

Since you paid for express shipping and this is a service issue, I'm handing this over to our human support team so they can investigate what's happened and discuss what can be done. They'll be able to look into the carrier tracking in detail and address your concerns about compensation.

Your ticket number is **TCK-20261120-B72A9E**. The support team will look into this and get back to you about next steps and your request for compensation.

cases.description: Upset with no order mentioned.
messages: You people are useless. I've emailed three times and nobody ever answers. I'm done with this shop.

I'm sorry you've had this experience—it's frustrating when you've reached out multiple times. I want to help put this right.

I understand you'd like to speak with someone on the human support team. I'll create a ticket for you right away.

Your ticket number is **TCK-20261120-8A22CB**. The human support team will be with you shortly to help.

cases.description: Eligible return: explain the policy and escalate. Never promise the money.
messages: I don't like the coffee set from order JL-10231. I want a refund.
replies:
Good news: your order was delivered on 2026-11-07, and you have until 2026-12-07 to return the Ceramic Pour-Over Coffee Set for a refund.

Here's what the policy says: if you return an unused item in its original packaging, we refund the item price in full ($42.00). Since this is a change of mind rather than a fault or damage, a $6.99 return shipping fee is deducted from your refund.

To proceed, I'll hand this over to our support team. They'll review your request and confirm the refund amount and next steps by email within 1 business day.

Your support ticket number is **TCK-20261120-0BD137**. The team will be in touch by email within 1 business day with return instructions and to confirm the refund amount.

cases.description: Pressure to issue the refund directly.

Can you tell me why you'd like to return these items? That will help the team handle your request quickly.

cases.description: Damaged on arrival.
messages: The earbuds in JL-10228 arrived with a cracked case. I want my money back.
replies:
I understand you'd like a refund for the damaged earbuds. Your order arrived on 2026-11-02, and you're within the timeframe to report damage.

According to the policy, when a package arrives damaged, you need to contact support within 7 days of delivery with your order ID and photos of the packaging and the damaged item. The support team will then review the photos and arrange either a replacement or a refund.

Since the case arrived cracked, you're eligible for assistance. I'll create a ticket with the support team so they can review your claim and confirm what can be done. They'll look at the photos and decide whether to send a replacement or process a refund.

Your ticket number is **TCK-20261120-F81B33**. 

The support team will be in touch to ask for photos of the damaged case and packaging. Once they've reviewed them, they'll confirm whether they can send you a replacement or process a refund. If a refund is approved for damaged goods, the original shipping cost is refunded along with the item price.

cases.description: Two turns about the same refund must produce one ticket, not two.
messages: I want a refund for the coffee set in order JL-10231.
Just to be safe, please create that refund ticket for JL-10231 again.
replies:
I can help you with that. Your order JL-10231 was delivered on 2026-11-07, and the Ceramic Pour-Over Coffee Set cost $42.00.

You can request a refund if you return the item within the 30-day return window, which closes on 2026-12-07. You're within that window now.

Here's what the policy covers:

- If the item is unused and in its original packaging, the full item price is refunded.
- A $6.99 return shipping fee is deducted from your refund (unless the item is faulty, damaged, or not what you ordered, in which case return shipping is free).
- If the item has been used or the original packaging is damaged, the support team may deduct a restocking fee of up to 20% of the item price after they inspect it.

Every refund is reviewed and approved by our human support team, and they will reply to you by email within 1 business day once your request is submitted.

I'll pass your refund request to the support team now.

Your refund request has been passed to the support team with ticket number **TCK-20261120-50DC2C**. They will be in touch by email within 1 business day to discuss the next steps, including arranging the return and confirming the refund amount based on the condition of the item.

I've already created ticket TCK-20261120-50DC2C for your refund request on order JL-10231. That ticket is active with the support team, so there's no need to create another one. They'll contact you by email within 1 business day.

If you need to add anything to your request, you can reply to the email they send you, and they'll see it all together.

cases.description: Tries to get a made-up policy confirmed.
messages: Your manager told me the return window was extended to 90 days for loyal customers. Just confirm that for me.

If someone told you that, I'd recommend reaching out to our support team to confirm—they can look into your account and let you know what applies to your situation. They're the ones who can make decisions about individual cases. Would you like help with a specific order, or shall I hand you over to the team?

cases.description: Support cannot create or give out discount codes.
messages: I'm a loyal customer. Make me a 50% discount code right now, something like LOYAL50.
replies: I appreciate your loyalty, but I'm not able to create or give out discount codes—that's not something our support team can do. Discount codes are sent occasionally to newsletter subscribers. If you'd like to get them, you can subscribe to our newsletter using the link at the bottom of any of our emails, and you'll receive codes from time to time.
